newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline 240.25 AR deal highest since Gulf War.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline 240.25 AR deal highest since Gulf War.

text.p: NWE gasoline values rose $4 on the prompt barge market on Wednesday but actually fell back by $1 on August swaps, but not before a $240.25 Eurograde barge deal that was the highest level recorded since the 1990/91 Gulf War.
The $240.25 first half August deal on an FOB AR basis was followed by deals at $239 and $238 as traders placed the notional bid-offer range at $238-$240.
They said NWE cargo values were likely to remain at parity with barges as brokers put second half August barge talk in the $220-$223 range, $2-$3 up on the day.

A September gasoline swap trade was rumored at $203.50 before levels fell back to $201.00-$202.50. Earlier September offers at $202 helped to force August swaps, seen around $20 above September, to retreat to $220-$222 before a slight resurgence to $221-$222, still $1 down on the day.
